content.title: About
content.content: Fresh mashed potato (NFS) is a ready‑to‑eat product made by boiling and puréeing selected fresh potatoes without any preservatives. It has a smooth, creamy texture, a mild flavor, and retains most of the nutrients of the original vegetable.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: NFS (Not From Concentrate) indicates the product is made from whole fresh potatoes, not from a reconstituted concentrate.
Mashed potato is a common component of infant foods because of its easy digestibility.
When stored properly, the product can maintain its quality for up to 12 months.
Potatoes are one of the most widely cultivated vegetables worldwide and mashed potato is a classic side dish.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Fresh potatoes provide vitamin C, which supports the immune system and collagen synthesis.

items.title: Good source of potassium
items.content: Potassium helps regulate fluid balance and supports normal heart function.

items.title: Contains dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber promotes healthy digestion and contributes to satiety.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Mashed potato without added butter or cream contains little saturated fat.

items.title: Contains vitamin B6
items.content: Vitamin B6 is involved in protein metabolism and neurotransmitter synthesis.

items.title: Potato allergy
items.content: A small number of individuals may experience an allergic reaction to potatoes.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: If salt is added to the finished product, intake should be monitored, especially for people with hypertension.

items.title: Bacterial growth after opening
items.content: Once the package is opened, keep the product refrigerated and consume within a few days to prevent bacterial contamination.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve as a side dish with meat, fish or vegetables, use in casseroles, soups, or infant meals. For extra flavor you can add butter, milk, or herbs and spices.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a sealed package in a cool, dry place. After opening, keep refrigerated and use within 5 days. Discard if an off‑odor or discoloration appears.
